name: Unwell
source:
Fisker lives a simple existence where he doesn't care for much of anything besides his job and next smoke.

The only thrill in his life is Chalk.

Whenever they meet, debauchery follows. Every moment he craves Chalk's sadistic goading and deranged pleasures. A consensual threat to blissful agony.

[From [url=https://lizardpaws.itch.io/unwell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
菲斯克过着简单的生活，除了工作和下一支烟之外，他对任何事情都不关心。

他一生中唯一的兴奋就是粉笔。

只要他们相遇，放荡就随之而来。他每时每刻都渴望查克的虐待狂刺激和疯狂的快乐。对幸福痛苦的自愿威胁。

[来自[url=https://lizardpaws.itch.io/unwell]Itch.io[/url]]
